#load data
```{r load data, include=FALSE}
library("ggplot2")
# library("plyr")  # CHANGES: plyr not available for R 4.6 - only rename() was used, now dplyr::rename()
library("dplyr")
library("car")
library("tidyr")
library("readxl")
# library("reshape2")  # CHANGES: reshape2 not available for R 4.6 - no reshape2 functions are used
library("tidyverse")
library("ggrepel")
library("tibble")
library("ggforce")
library("lubridate")
library("esc")
library("effsize")
library("metafor")
library("corrplot")
library("MASS")
library("meta")
library("metafor")
library("installr")
library("crayon")
library("stringr")
library("tibble")
library(here)  # CHANGES: added
source(here("config.R"))  # CHANGES: added

DS_final<-read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "df_1.csv"))
DS_final<-DS_final[,-c(1)]


#plot-level df
DS_final$Distinct_Plots<-paste(DS_final$Dataset_ID,DS_final$Treatment,sep="_")
DS_final$Distinct_Plots<-paste(DS_final$Distinct_Plots,DS_final$Plot_ID,sep="_")
DS_final$Distinct_Plots<-as.factor(DS_final$Distinct_Plots)
DS_final$Plot_ID<-as.factor(DS_final$Plot_ID)
DS_final$Treatment<-as.factor(DS_final$Treatment)

df_PLOT_LEVEL<-DS_final %>%  distinct(Distinct_Plots, .keep_all = TRUE)   


```



#Hedges SMD (standardized mean diff)
##climate
```{r climate, warnings=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
############### AIR TEMP (AT) ###############

DS_final_AT<-DS_final[-which(is.na(DS_final$Air_Temp)),]

dfSummary_AT<-DS_final_AT %>% group_by(Dataset_ID, Treatment) %>% summarize(MEAN=mean(Air_Temp), SDEV=sd(Air_Temp), SS=n())

dfSummary_ATCTL <- dfSummary_AT  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="CTL")
dfSummary_ATOTC <- dfSummary_AT  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="OTC")
dfSummary_AT <- full_join(dfSummary_ATCTL, dfSummary_ATOTC, by="Dataset_ID")

dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("MEAN_CTL"="MEAN.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("MEAN_OTC"="MEAN.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("SDEV_CTL"="SDEV.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("SDEV_OTC"="SDEV.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("SS_CTL"="SS.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("SS_OTC"="SS.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

# Calculate actual effect sizes per dataset (Raw SMD)
SMDAT <-
  escalc("SMD", m1i = MEAN_OTC,
    n1i = SS_OTC,
    sd1i = SDEV_OTC,
    m2i = MEAN_CTL,
    n2i = SS_CTL,
    sd2i = SDEV_CTL,
    data = dfSummary_AT 
  )

SMDAT<-dplyr::rename(SMDAT,any_of(c("Hedges_SMDAT"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
SMDAT<-dplyr::rename(SMDAT,any_of(c("Hedges_SMDAT_VARIANCE"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

Mean_SMDAT<-mean(SMDAT$Hedges_SMDAT)
Mean_SMDAT

#Add confidence intervals
SMDAT$CI_lb<-SMDAT$Hedges_SMDAT-1.96*sqrt(SMDAT$Hedges_SMDAT_VARIANCE)
SMDAT$CI_ub<-SMDAT$Hedges_SMDAT+1.96*sqrt(SMDAT$Hedges_SMDAT_VARIANCE)



############### SOIL TEMP (AT) ###############

DS_final_ST<-DS_final[-which(is.na(DS_final$Soil_Temp)),]

dfSummary_ST<-DS_final_ST %>% group_by(Dataset_ID, Treatment) %>% summarize(MEAN=mean(Soil_Temp), SDEV=sd(Soil_Temp), SS=n())

dfSummary_STCTL <- dfSummary_ST  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="CTL")
dfSummary_STOTC <- dfSummary_ST  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="OTC")
dfSummary_ST <- full_join(dfSummary_STCTL, dfSummary_STOTC, by="Dataset_ID")

dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("MEAN_CTL"="MEAN.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("MEAN_OTC"="MEAN.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("SDEV_CTL"="SDEV.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("SDEV_OTC"="SDEV.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("SS_CTL"="SS.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("SS_OTC"="SS.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

SMDST <-
  escalc("SMD", m1i = MEAN_OTC,
    n1i = SS_OTC,
    sd1i = SDEV_OTC,
    m2i = MEAN_CTL,
    n2i = SS_CTL,
    sd2i = SDEV_CTL,
    data = dfSummary_ST 
  )

SMDST<-dplyr::rename(SMDST,any_of(c("Hedges_SMDST"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
SMDST<-dplyr::rename(SMDST,any_of(c("Hedges_SMDST_VARIANCE"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

Mean_SMDST<-mean(SMDST$Hedges_SMDST)
Mean_SMDST

SMDST$CI_lb<-SMDST$Hedges_SMDST-1.96*sqrt(SMDST$Hedges_SMDST_VARIANCE)
SMDST$CI_ub<-SMDST$Hedges_SMDST+1.96*sqrt(SMDST$Hedges_SMDST_VARIANCE)




############### SOIL MOIST (AT) ###############

DS_final_SM<-DS_final[-which(is.na(DS_final$SM)),]

dfSummary_SM<-DS_final_SM %>% group_by(Dataset_ID, Treatment) %>% summarize(MEAN=mean(SM), SDEV=sd(SM), SS=n())

dfSummary_SMCTL <- dfSummary_SM  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="CTL")
dfSummary_SMOTC <- dfSummary_SM  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="OTC")
dfSummary_SM <- full_join(dfSummary_SMCTL, dfSummary_SMOTC, by="Dataset_ID")

dfSummary_SM<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_SM,any_of(c("MEAN_CTL"="MEAN.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_SM<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_SM,any_of(c("MEAN_OTC"="MEAN.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_SM<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_SM,any_of(c("SDEV_CTL"="SDEV.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_SM<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_SM,any_of(c("SDEV_OTC"="SDEV.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_SM<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_SM,any_of(c("SS_CTL"="SS.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_SM<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_SM,any_of(c("SS_OTC"="SS.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

SMDSM <-
  escalc("SMD", m1i = MEAN_OTC,
    n1i = SS_OTC,
    sd1i = SDEV_OTC,
    m2i = MEAN_CTL,
    n2i = SS_CTL,
    sd2i = SDEV_CTL,
    data = dfSummary_SM 
  )

SMDSM<-dplyr::rename(SMDSM,any_of(c("Hedges_SMDSM"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
SMDSM<-dplyr::rename(SMDSM,any_of(c("Hedges_SMDSM_VARIANCE"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

Mean_SMDSM<-mean(SMDSM$Hedges_SMDSM)
Mean_SMDSM

SMDSM$CI_lb<-SMDSM$Hedges_SMDSM-1.96*sqrt(SMDSM$Hedges_SMDSM_VARIANCE)
SMDSM$CI_ub<-SMDSM$Hedges_SMDSM+1.96*sqrt(SMDSM$Hedges_SMDSM_VARIANCE)


write.csv(dfSummary_AT, file.path(output_data_dir, "dfSummaryAT.csv"))
write.csv(dfSummary_ST, file.path(output_data_dir, "dfSummaryST.csv"))
write.csv(dfSummary_SM, file.path(output_data_dir, "dfSummarySM.csv"))

write.csv(SMDAT, file.path(output_data_dir, "SMDAT.csv"))
write.csv(SMDST, file.path(output_data_dir, "SMDST.csv"))
write.csv(SMDSM, file.path(output_data_dir, "SMDSM.csv"))
```

```{r climate 2, warnings=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#CHANGE: chunk renamed from 'climate' to 'climate 2' (duplicate label)
############### AIR TEMP (AT) ###############

DS_final_AT<-DS_final[-which(is.na(DS_final$Air_Temp)),]

dfSummary_AT<-DS_final_AT %>% group_by(Dataset_ID, Treatment) %>% summarize(MEAN=mean(Air_Temp), SDEV=sd(Air_Temp), SS=n())

dfSummary_ATCTL <- dfSummary_AT  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="CTL")
dfSummary_ATOTC <- dfSummary_AT  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="OTC")
dfSummary_AT <- full_join(dfSummary_ATCTL, dfSummary_ATOTC, by="Dataset_ID")

dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("MEAN_CTL"="MEAN.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("MEAN_OTC"="MEAN.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("SDEV_CTL"="SDEV.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("SDEV_OTC"="SDEV.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("SS_CTL"="SS.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_AT<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_AT,any_of(c("SS_OTC"="SS.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

# Calculate actual effect sizes per dataset (Raw RMD)
RMDAT <-
  escalc("MD", m1i = MEAN_OTC,
    n1i = SS_OTC,
    sd1i = SDEV_OTC,
    m2i = MEAN_CTL,
    n2i = SS_CTL,
    sd2i = SDEV_CTL,
    data = dfSummary_AT 
  )

RMDAT<-dplyr::rename(RMDAT,any_of(c("RMDAT"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
RMDAT<-dplyr::rename(RMDAT,any_of(c("RMDAT_VARIANCE"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

Mean_RMDAT<-mean(RMDAT$RMDAT)
Mean_RMDAT

#Add confidence intervals
RMDAT$CI_lb<-RMDAT$RMDAT-1.96*sqrt(RMDAT$RMDAT_VARIANCE)
RMDAT$CI_ub<-RMDAT$RMDAT+1.96*sqrt(RMDAT$RMDAT_VARIANCE)



############### SOIL TEMP (ST) ###############

DS_final_ST<-DS_final[-which(is.na(DS_final$Soil_Temp)),]

dfSummary_ST<-DS_final_ST %>% group_by(Dataset_ID, Treatment) %>% summarize(MEAN=mean(Soil_Temp), SDEV=sd(Soil_Temp), SS=n())

dfSummary_STCTL <- dfSummary_ST  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="CTL")

dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("MEAN_CTL"="MEAN.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("MEAN_OTC"="MEAN.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("SDEV_CTL"="SDEV.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("SDEV_OTC"="SDEV.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("SS_CTL"="SS.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary_ST<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary_ST,any_of(c("SS_OTC"="SS.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

  escalc("MD", m1i = MEAN_OTC,

    sd1i = SDEV_OTC,
```
